## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to AI Face Detector.

## 💡 Use Case

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🎨 Alternatives

Describe alternative solutions or features you've considered.

What are the drawbacks of these alternatives?

## 📊 Impact

How would this feature impact the project?

- **Performance**: [Better/Worse/No change]
- **Complexity**: [More complex/Simpler/No change]
- **Dependencies**: [New dependencies required/No new dependencies]

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link any related issues or PRs here.

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## 🤝 Contribution

Are you interested in implementing this feature yourself?
